title: Michael made to undress for examination by base personnel

tellings.quote: I had to be in a room with a bunch of men undressed

plain: Michael Johnson, a former US Air Force guard at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, says that after a strange encounter at a missile site around November 1977, he was examined on base. On the podcast of host Jesse Michels, he says he had to stand undressed in a room with a group of men. If true, it would suggest the Air Force took the event seriously and checked the guards afterwards.
